metadata.services: Triple Play Bundle: Fiber 500 + Digital TV + Voice ($110/mo)

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is David. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi David. I'm having a bit of a silly problem. I can't seem to remember the PIN for my voicemail.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not a silly problem at all, that happens to everyone! I can definitely help you with resetting that. I just need to verify your account first for security.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Of course, that makes sense.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I start with your full name, please?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: It's Patricia Robinson.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Patricia. And the phone number associated with the account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. One moment while I pull up your account information... Okay, I see your account here. The final verification step is your four-digit account security PIN. This would be the one you set up for calling in, not the voicemail PIN.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh dear, another PIN. Let me think... I think I know this one. Is it 5755?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's it! Thank you for verifying your information, Ms. Robinson. Your account is now securely authenticated.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Wonderful. So you can help me with the voicemail?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely. The process is very straightforward. I can reset your voicemail PIN to a temporary one from my end. Then, the next time you call your voicemail, it will prompt you to create a new one.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That sounds perfect. What do I need to do?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Nothing just yet. Just give me one moment to access the voice service settings for your line. It should only take about 30 seconds.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Take your time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, thank you for your patience. I have now reset your voicemail PIN. Your temporary PIN is the last four digits of your phone number.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: The last four... so that would be 5-8-6-9?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's correct, 5-8-6-9.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, so I just call my voicemail and use that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly. Once you enter that temporary PIN, the automated system will guide you through setting up a new, permanent PIN of your choosing.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Could I... could I try it now while I have you on the line? Just in case.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. I'd be happy to wait on the line with you to make sure it works.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you so much. I'll just need a moment to dial in. I'm using my landline to call you, so I'll use my cell phone to check the voicemail.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No problem at all. Take your time.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, I'm dialing now... It's ringing... Okay, the automated voice is asking for my PIN.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. Go ahead and enter 5-8-6-9.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, entering it... one moment...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is everything alright on your end?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes! It worked. It said 'Welcome to your voicemail box'. Now it's saying 'For security, you must now change your PIN. Please enter your new PIN, then press pound.'

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. That's exactly what we wanted to hear. You can go ahead and choose a new four-to-six digit PIN. Just try to make it something you'll remember but that isn't too simple, like 1-2-3-4.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, I have one in mind. Let me just type it in... Okay... Now it's asking me to enter it again to confirm.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Alright, I've confirmed it. It says 'Your PIN has been changed successfully. You have... one new message.'

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Fantastic! It sounds like you're all set. You have successfully reset your PIN and can now access your voicemail.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes! Oh, thank you so much, David. I was worried I'd lost those messages. You've been a great help.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was my pleasure, Ms. Robinson. I'm glad we could get that sorted out for you quickly.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I should write this one down somewhere safe this time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's always a good idea. Before I let you go, was there anything else I could assist you with today? Any questions about your bill or other Cymbal services?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that was the only thing. Everything else has been working great. The fiber internet is wonderful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We love to hear that! Our Fiber 500 plan is very popular.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, my son recommended it. He said Cymbal was the best in the area.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's very kind of him to say. We strive to provide the best service possible.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Well, you've certainly helped me today. Thanks again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are very welcome. Thank you for being a Cymbal Telecom customer, Ms. Robinson. Have a wonderful rest of your day.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too, David. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.
